messages:
Maya: quick follow-up from the SEV-124 postmortem — we need runbook/playbook updates + owners for remediation items. I'll summarize below.

Maya: Action list:
- A1: Add triage checklist for runtime OOMs (owner: Zia) — include kubectl/logs, kv-cache check, fallback model switch. due 2026-05-03
- A2: Detection rule: recurring tokenization spike alert (owner: Ryan) — alert when p50>200ms AND error_rate>0.5% for 5m. due 2026-05-06
- A3: Rollback/playbook for hot model rollout (owner: Sam) — add escalation and automatic fallback. due 2026-05-10

Ryan: I'll take the detection rule. Proposed alert query:
```
sum by(model) (rate(redwood_inference_request_latency_seconds_bucket{le="0.2"}[5m])) / sum by(model)(rate(redwood_inference_requests_total[5m])) < 0.8
```
Will add doc with thresholds and runbooks for false-positive tuning.

Zia: I'll update triage steps. Draft commands to include:
- kubectl -n inference logs -l app=redwood-runtime --tail=200
- kubectl exec -n inference svc/runtime -- /bin/sh -c "cat /mnt/kvcache/stats || true"
- curl -s https://api.redwood-internal/metrics?model=NAME | jq .latency
I'll open a PR to docs/runbooks/oom-troubleshoot.md and link here.

Sam: I'll own the rollback/playbook. Escalation path proposal:
- 0-5m: Oncall (page, 2 min escalate)
- 5-15m: Eng-SRE (pager)
- 15-60m: Infra lead + Eng oncall + Customer Success (email)
Include fallback: switch to quantized variant or degrade to cached responses. I'll put steps and commands.

ops-bot: Reminder: created task TRACK-453 in action-tracker (https://go.track/453). assigned to Maya, due 2026-05-10.

Maya: For recurring pattern — let's add a periodic audit: weekly telemetry check for top-10 models and SLO drift. Ryan to add alert, Zia to add playbook step to run audit.

Ryan: noted. I'll create the alert + grafana dashboard panel (panel id TBD) and add runbook link.

Zia: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/312 — triage checklist added, still needs commands sanitized. target merge EOD 2026-04-28.

Sam: I'll draft the rollback playbook in docs/playbooks/hot-rollout-revert.md and ping @maya for review.

Maya: thanks all. Could folks add their owner tag in the action-tracker and set the due date? I'll follow up in weekly incident follow-up meeting.

Ryan: done :thumbsup:

Zia: added owner + due :white_check_mark:

Sam: added draft and owner. starting testing tomorrow.

Maya: closing thread once PRs merged and TRACK-453 is current. ping me on slack if blockers.
